events.name: US Dallas Fed Manufacturing Index
events.description: Regional Federal Reserve survey of Texas factory activity, an early gauge of US manufacturing sentiment and output.

events.name: China Industrial Profits (Y-o-Y, YTD)
events.description: Cumulative year-to-date profit growth at large Chinese industrial firms, signalling corporate health and manufacturing momentum.

events.name: RBA Interest Rate Decision
events.description: Reserve Bank of Australia's cash rate decision, a key signal of monetary policy direction for the Australian economy.

events.name: US Consumer Confidence (Conference Board)
events.description: Survey of US household sentiment on current conditions and job prospects, a leading indicator of consumer spending.

events.name: US PCE Price Index (Y-o-Y)
events.description: The Fed's preferred inflation gauge, tracking price changes across consumer spending and shaping the outlook for policy.

events.name: China Manufacturing PMI (NBS)
events.description: Official gauge of factory activity in China, indicating whether manufacturing output is expanding or contracting.

events.name: US Initial Jobless Claims
events.description: Weekly tally of new US unemployment benefit claims, offering a fast, high-frequency read on labour market strength.

events.name: Japan Tankan Large Manufacturers Index
events.description: BoJ's quarterly survey of large manufacturers' business sentiment, a key input for Japan's monetary policy outlook.

events.name: US Nonfarm Payrolls
events.description: Monthly change in US employment excluding farms, the most closely watched gauge of labour market strength and Fed policy.

events.name: Eurozone HICP Inflation (Flash, Y-o-Y)
events.description: Preliminary euro area inflation estimate, a critical input for the ECB's interest rate and policy decisions.
